children: Mobile Global Esports, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with initial product revenue and a widening net loss versus the year-ago quarter as the company invests in platform development and commercialization. Revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2026 was $15557 compared with $0 in the year-ago quarter; net loss attributable to Mobile Global Esports, Inc. was $(526,011) versus $(448,389) in Q2 2025, and net loss per share, basic and diluted, was $(0.01) in both periods.
Revenue: $15,557 for Q2 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026) vs. $0 in the year-ago quarter (not meaningful YoY).
Net income: Net loss attributable to Mobile Global Esports, Inc. $(526,011) for Q2 2026 vs. net loss $(448,389) in Q2 2025 (worsened YoY).
Diluted EPS: Net loss per share, basic and diluted $(0.01) for Q2 2026 vs. $(0.01) for Q2 2025.
Revenue Growth: Reported initial revenue from the RSO Platform and Dominus Sports — approximately $16K in Q2 and ~$22K year-to-date, up from zero in the prior year.
Product Commercialization: Launched Dominus Sports beta (fantasy baseball) featuring multi-tier team ownership and microtransactions.
Channel & Portfolio Shift: Acquired RSO (a dynasty football platform) and discontinued the India subsidiary MOGO to concentrate resources on Dominus Sports.
Operational Investment: Increased platform costs and capitalization of R&D have driven higher hosting, development expenses and software amortization as the company scales its platforms.
